source.recallDefinition: Tie-aware Recall@10; exact equal-score boundary ties are credited. Overall recall excludes six empty-ground-truth query identities.
source.qpsDefinition: Mixed workload search throughput: 180 unfiltered and 20 filtered evaluation query identities, repeatedly executed. Recall postprocessing is excluded from the search timer.
source.cpuDefinition: Average Docker CPU percent summed over DB deployment containers; 100 percent corresponds to one CPU core, so the four-core budget is 400 percent.
source.ramDefinition: Peak Docker observed DB deployment memory, bytes divided by 1073741824 (GiB). Includes companion services where applicable. Descriptive metric, no 2 GiB rejection threshold.
source.warmDefinition: true means the recorded warmup stability criterion passed; false is a warning, not a deleted observation.
source.suspectDefinition: Previously identified within-measurement Recall variation: Milvus DISKANN run 1 search_list=10, run 2 search_list=200, run 3 search_list=10, run 4 search_list=120, run 5 search_list=120. Retain and flag, not automatically delete.
source.aggregation: Each group fixes DB, engine, index, index parameters, and search parameter. For group-level charts, display mean Recall and median p95/QPS/CPU/peak-RAM with all five run values or min-max range. Do not apply eligibility thresholds.
limitations: Only synthetic 10k chunks were measured; 1k performance and real project data are not measured.
Exploratory search grid reused evaluation observations; not independent holdout validation.
Filtered latency includes six empty-ground-truth query identities; filtered Recall scores only fourteen query identities.
No final DB winner or service suitability claim is encoded.
Raw latency includes adapter/client effects; known Milvus drift diagnostic and warmup limitations remain.
